_doc: The two ways a workspace hosts a chart part. Both are FormPartControl containers; only the parent tab page differs.
Shapes taken from RetailITWorkspace (chart tile in the SectionTiles page) and CustomerCollectionManagerWorkspace / CostAnalysisWorkspace (SectionStackedChart page).
targetName is the AxMenuItemDisplay whose Object is the chart part form - never the form name.

Splice with xpp_patch_by_path op=append: chartTile into '/design/controls/<FastTabs>/controls/<SummaryTabPage>/controls'; stackedChartPage into '/design/controls/<FastTabs>/controls' (after the SectionTabbedList page, before SectionPowerBI / SectionRelatedLinks).

chartTile._doc: Append to the SectionTiles tab page's controls, alongside the TileButtonControl buttons. The part's chart control carries ExtendedStyle chart_2x2 so it flows in the tile grid.
chartTile.name: MyOrdersByDayChartTile

stackedChartPage._doc: A whole tab page: Section Stacked Chart, one or two FormPartControls only. Caption is required by BP. autoDeclaration=true on a host is only needed when the workspace X++ calls <host>.getPartFormRun().
stackedChartPage.name: ChartsSection
stackedChartPage.caption: @MyLabels:OrdersTrend
